{"id":1891801322,"question_id":3611,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months","timestamp":1768975750,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1891801322/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Construct the Minimum Bitwise Array II","memory":"28.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> minBitwiseArray(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>ans(n , -1);\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(nums[i] == 2) ans[i] = -1;\n            \n            for(int j = 0 ; j<32 ; j++)\n            {\n                //if it is set bit then skip\n                if(nums[i] & (1<<j)) continue;\n                else\n                {\n                    if(j == 0) break;\n                    //make previous bit zero to get x\n                    int prev_bit_pos = j-1;\n                    //taking the XOR of shhifted one by j-1 times gives the desired x\n                    ans[i] = nums[i] ^ (1 << prev_bit_pos);\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"construct-the-minimum-bitwise-array-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1526}
